CMLIT 10.name: World Literatures
CMLIT 10.description: The development of literature around the world, from oral tradition to modern written forms. Gen Ed Humanities, International Cultures.

CMLIT 100.name: Reading Across Cultures
CMLIT 100.description: Explores the practical aspects of dealing with literary works in a comparative global context. Gen Ed Humanities, Global Learning.

CMLIT 400Y.name: Senior Seminar in Literary Criticism and Theory
CMLIT 400Y.description: Capstone seminar in literary criticism and theory. Bulletin requires 7th-semester standing and 18 credits in literature, which the planner schema does not model directly.
